FX.OWN.TOTL.ZS.label: Account ownership, all adults
FX.OWN.TOTL.ZS.definition: Share of adults (15+) who report having an account, alone or with someone else, at a bank or another type of financial institution, or personally using a mobile-money service in the past 12 months.

FX.OWN.TOTL.FE.ZS.label: Account ownership, women
FX.OWN.TOTL.FE.ZS.definition: As for all adults, restricted to women aged 15+.

FX.OWN.TOTL.40.ZS.label: Account ownership, poorest 40%
FX.OWN.TOTL.40.ZS.definition: Account ownership among adults in the poorest 40% of households, ranked by household income within the country (as defined by Findex).

FX.OWN.TOTL.60.ZS.label: Account ownership, richest 60%
FX.OWN.TOTL.60.ZS.definition: Account ownership among adults in the richest 60% of households, ranked by household income within the country (as defined by Findex).

FS.AST.PRVT.GD.ZS.label: Domestic credit to private sector
FS.AST.PRVT.GD.ZS.definition: Financial resources provided to the private sector by financial corporations -- loans, purchases of non-equity securities, trade credit and other claims for repayment -- as a share of GDP.

FD.AST.PRVT.GD.ZS.label: Domestic credit to private sector by banks
FD.AST.PRVT.GD.ZS.definition: Credit to the private sector from deposit-taking corporations other than the central bank, as a share of GDP.

CM.MKT.LCAP.GD.ZS.label: Market capitalisation of listed domestic companies
CM.MKT.LCAP.GD.ZS.definition: Share price times shares outstanding for listed domestic companies, year-end, as a share of GDP (investment funds and pure holding companies excluded).
